description: Updates a custom signal you own: its expression, description or name.

description.description: New description. Not derived from `expr`, so change both if the prose describes a threshold you are moving.

expr.description: New SQL expression. Re-validated and re-inlined against your other custom signals. Same strict grammar as create: no `LIKE`/`ILIKE`, `CASE`, `::` casts or functions beyond `abs`/`coalesce`/`round`/`least`/`greatest`. The response echoes your expression as stored, not its expansion (a pre-2026-09-07 signal spelling is stored under its current name and reported in `_meta.deprecated_signals`).

new_name.description: New slug: renames the signal and changes its API handle everywhere (same validation as create). Refused while other custom signals reference the current name.

signal.description: Custom signal slug (the signal name). A built-in name answers 404: built-ins are read-only.

name: tickerbot_update_custom_signal
